_comment: Copy this to training_plan.json and fill in your own plan. That file is git-ignored so your personal details never get committed. All fields are free-form context for the coach — add or remove keys as you like.

athlete.name: Your Name
athlete.context: A sentence or two of background the coach should know: your history, current focus, and limiters.

philosophy.priority: What matters most and why (e.g. which sport or goal leads).
philosophy.structure: How you structure hard vs. easy days (e.g. polarized).
known_patterns: Any personal patterns the coach should watch for (e.g. power drifts up late in rides).

near_term: A goal or two for the next month.

longer_term.target: A longer-range target and rough date.

current_block.name: Name of your current training block
current_block.focus: What this block is working on, and roughly when.

weekly_template.note: The general shape of your week and how it flexes.
weekly_template.wednesday: e.g. Long run or easy ride

fueling.notes: Any fueling approach the coach should factor in.
